_comment: Adventurers Guild for CHIM (1.6.0): what AdventurersGuild.dll reports to the Guild's CHIM server plugin about the people near the player. factions: the factions the knowledge pack's per-NPC entries depend on (their condition_expr), 'Plugin|0xID'; the DLL tells the server which of them the speaker is in. plugins: the other mods the pack has entries for; only the loaded ones are taught to CHIM. src/chim/build_dwpkg.py fails if the pack names a faction or plugin missing here.
